transcript.user: Will cookbook/native.yaml actually run if I deploy it?

To address these issues:

- Ensure the baseOS correctly describes the runtime used.
- Verify if public exposure of sensitive data is intended or correct.

results.title: Docs question about the action contract

transcript.user: What happens if Hyperion sends delete_file with only a file name?
transcript.steward: When Hyperion sends `delete_file` with only a file name, it searches for a file (or files) in the workspace that matches the name. If there is ambiguity (i.e., multiple files with the same name, or several files whose names share parts of the given name), it will return "409 Ambiguous file name, matches: [list of matching files]". If there is no ambiguity, it will proceed to ask the user for confirmation to delete the selected file. No files will be actually deleted until the user confirms.
